_comment: Suite wayfinding SSOT v2. Rail has 3 user-facing stops (Learn, Run, Ledger). Concepts lists the 5 conceptual loop steps used only in journey diagrams on chaingraph-hub and the Ledger About tab. The Ledger stop carries a microtext row (verify, anchor, keep) showing in-place actions. To INSERT a rail stop (e.g. Authorize before Run), add an entry at the desired index and update lit-step values in WAYFINDER sentinels. The generator (scripts/gen-wayfinder.mjs) reads rail[] and re-renders on every build.

_insertNotes.Authorize_before_Run: Insert {id:'authorize', label:'Authorize', url:'https://ainumbers.co/chaingraph/work-mandates.html', one_line_role:'Sign work mandates that govern what agents may run'} at index 1 (before run). Existing WAYFINDER:run sentinel pages keep their sentinel id. Regenerate all with gen-wayfinder.mjs.
_insertNotes.VM_inside_Run: Add {name:'Kernel VM', url:'https://ainumbers.co/chaingraph/kernel-vm.html', audience:'both'} to rail step 'run' surfaces array.
_insertNotes.BX1_inside_Run: Add {name:'Boundary Explorer', url:'https://ainumbers.co/chaingraph/boundary-explorer.html', audience:'both'} to rail step 'run' surfaces.
_insertNotes.ML3_inside_Ledger: Exception queue is a tab inside the Ledger. Add {name:'Exception Queue', url:'https://ledger.ainumbers.co/#exceptions', audience:'human'} to rail step 'ledger' surfaces.
